scope: Public-safe bounded ecosystem freshness, deterministic graph baseline, footer correction, and regenerated graph/report artifacts. No private source inventory is included.

boundedIterations: Freshness: initial regressions exposed false offline currentness and omitted new remote heads. Implemented all-head observation and explicit coverage gaps.
Independent review exposed impossible-calendar-date acceptance; reproduced red and fixed canonical ISO round-trip validation.
Footer: two regressions failed on prior wording; removed internal label and unsupported future promise, retaining negative controls.
Graph baseline: 0/2 red became 2/2 green with the exact immutable comparison snapshot and missing-history hold.
Aggregate evaluation caught the renamed criterion not being wired into the manifest; 0/1 red became 1/1 green with an exact criterion-set regression.
hillClimb.independentReview: Separate non-author agents reviewed the corrected evaluator, baseline adapter and aggregate wiring; no remaining actionable findings in those bounded changes. Not human approval or calibrated quality measurement.

employmentReports.boundary: Deterministic public-evidence diagnostic refresh, not new official posting research or hiring approval.

wikiHillclimb.reached: graph/report generation and current-output checks passed; stopped at inherited accessibility receipt failure in wiki:test

fullCheck.firstStop: professor-lens candidate fingerprint and 0/6 matching passing holdout scorecards

build.boundary: Local build, not deployment; first restricted-network font fetch failed, subsequent build with network access succeeded.

remoteProfileObservation.boundary: The retained historical profile does not become a current exhaustive review. Counts exclude all private branch locators.

hostedCi: Not established by these local checks; exact-head readback belongs in the pull-request update.
